def solve():

    ptr = 0
    t = int(input[ptr])
    ptr += 1
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[ptr])
        ptr += 1
        a = list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr + n]))
        ptr += n
        b = list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr + n]))
        ptr += n
        c = list(map(int, input[ptr:ptr + n]))
        ptr += n

        p = [0] * n
        p[0] = a[0]
        for i in range(1, n):
            options = [x for x in [a[i], b[i], c[i]] if x != p[i-1]]
            p[i] = options[0]
        if p[-1] == p[0]:
            for i in range(n):
                options = [x for x in [a[i], b[i], c[i]] if x != p[(i-1) % n] and x != p[(i+1) % n]]
